data.content_ref: inline:Maintain the grounded extension incrementally under a stream of attack/support insertions, reusing the previous fixed point rather than recomputing from scratch, with amortized polynomial update cost and a final result proven independent of update order. This targets practical scalability of the existing semantics without adding expressiveness or new artifacts. Criticizable: amortized bounds are fragile under adversarial insertion sequences; proving update-order independence of the final fixed point is as hard as the determinism question it inherits; intermediate (pre-commit) states may be observably inconsistent, which could violate the validity-of-committed-roots guarantee if any intermediate state is ever read.
